title: The 600-page fake
text: An AI-fabricated ~600-page 'Tisza programme', stuffed with invented measures (an extra tax on pets), is leaked to Index and printed on nationwide Fidesz posters. A court later rules the austerity claims false.

title: The campaign director's deepfake
text: Fidesz campaign director Balázs Orbán posts a realistic AI deepfake of Péter Magyar 'announcing' a pension policy he never proposed — one of the few high-deception-risk deepfakes of the campaign.

title: A phone call that never happened
text: An AI video of Ursula von der Leyen phoning Magyar to 'order' money sent to Ukraine reaches millions of views — produced by a Megafon-owned proxy and reposted by Viktor Orbán's own Facebook page.

title: A fabricated accusation
text: A fake 'Oknyomozó Riport' outlet publishes a fabricated pedophilia accusation against pastor Gábor Iványi, linking him to Magyar. Facebook ads push it to ~100,000–120,000 users, mostly over 65. Methods point to Storm-1516.

title: The fixers arrive
text: VSquare reports a three-person GRU-linked team operating from Russia's Budapest embassy under diplomatic cover, overseen by Sergei Kiriyenko — following the Moldova playbook. Corroborated by the Washington Post.

title: The Kremlin signs off
text: The FT reports the Kremlin approved a plan drafted by the sanctioned Social Design Agency — of Doppelgänger fame — to flood Hungarian social media with pro-Orbán content designed in Russia and posted by Hungarian influencers. Peskov denies it.

title: Ten million views of synthetic anchors
text: NewsGuard flags a 34-account TikTok network — most created within two days — using AI-generated news anchors and celebrity deepfakes to boost Orbán and smear Magyar, with ~10M cumulative views. TikTok removes it as a covert operation; origin unconfirmed.

title: A staged assassination, on paper
text: The Washington Post reports an SVR document codenamed 'Gamechanger' proposing a staged assassination attempt on Orbán, to paint Magyar and Brussels as warmongers. No attack occurs; the Kremlin dismisses the report.

title: Impersonating the newsrooms
text: The Matryoshka network activates on X, TikTok and Telegram from hijacked accounts, impersonating Deutsche Welle, Euronews and Kyiv Independent — but gains no real traction in Hungary and appears to bait fact-checkers to inflate its own reach.

title: 456 of 457
text: Researchers count 457 political ads on Meta in Jan–Feb 2026 despite the EU ad ban — 456 Fidesz-linked, zero Tisza. Meta caught only 19 of 162 January ads before they reached voters.

title: The vote
text: Tisza wins 141 of 199 seats — a two-thirds supermajority — ending Viktor Orbán's 16 years in power. The most AI-saturated campaign in EU history did not deliver the result it was built for.

title: The machine goes quiet
text: Post-election analyses judge the campaigns largely ineffective — often debunked faster than they spread, with counter-narratives outperforming them. Megafon shuts down entirely; the state-media apparatus is dismantled.
